title: Synthesis of a zeolite-a/MOF-5 composite for the defluoridation of groundwater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15200-15217
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01995H, Paper
Open Access

Tessema Derbe, Taju Sani, Enyew Amare Zereffa
To reduce excessive F− concentrations in groundwater, a novel zeolite-A/MOF-5 (Z-A/MOF-5) composite was synthesized through the solvothermal method. The composite's defluoridation performance was tested on real water samples and it showed promise as an adsorbent for practical application.
